items.issue: The male editorial narrator is not shown or independently authenticated as Mikey.
items.disposition: Attribute all narration generically and disable first-person use.

items.issue: The alleged concert dialogue, relationship, ticket purchase, chronology and later behavior rely on edited footage, reposts and unspecified online witnesses.
items.disposition: Keep every incident detail as an allegation and do not use it as factual support for advice.

items.issue: The 沸羊羊 and 小仙女 labels turn an unverified event into a gendered ridicule narrative.
items.disposition: Preserve only as editorial framing; do not generalize the labels to people or relationships.

items.issue: Identifiable concert attendees, online comments, reposted text, street footage and ticket images may expose third-party personal information.
items.disposition: Do not package or republish the imagery without privacy, provenance and redaction review.

items.issue: S00027-S00029 are materially garbled and cannot support a reliable ending claim.
items.disposition: Exclude the garbled wording from claims and treat the tail only as ticket imagery/noisy outro.
